Ultra-high Precision ADAS Calibration Tool

- Electric lifting and manual adjustment for fast and portable operation. 
- Millimetre precision laser range-finder for accurate measurements. No need for mechanical measurement anymore. 
- The professional diagnostic software on a LAUNCH scan tool provides step by step instruction to help users quickly perform calibrations correctly. 
- New upgraded Aluminium Alloy material for durable use. 
- The OE standard targets are compatible with the X-431 ADAS Mobile PLUS. 
- Equipped with detachable tablet stand. 
- Various ADAS calibration systems are supported, including LDW, ACC, RCW, AVM, BSD, NVS, etc.
